episodes.title: Hell Is Other People
episodes.summary: Plain bad luck awaits Yoon Jong Woo on his first day in the big city. He finds a cheap place to live and vows he will stay there only for a short while.

episodes.title: Human Nature
episodes.summary: Jong Woo receives unwanted attention from his neighbors but none at all from his supervisor at work. Meanwhile, dead cats are found near Eden.

episodes.title: The Secret Whisper
episodes.summary: On the building rooftop, Jong Woo meets Seo Moon Jo, who has taken a liking to him. They bond over their mutual interest in crime and art.

episodes.title: Mental Derangement
episodes.summary: Something about Moon Jo and the mystery meat rests uneasily with Jong Woo, causing his nightmares to worsen. Uhm Bok Soon's lies come to light.

episodes.title: Malte's Notebook
episodes.summary: There's been an intruder. But before Jong Woo is able to catch the person who broke into his room, Moon Jo pulls him aside to offer a word of advice.

episodes.title: Lost
episodes.summary: When Min Ji Eun stops by Eden alone, Jong Woo rushes home with the police — only to have her lash out at him for overreacting. He needs to get out.

episodes.title: The Horror of the Basement
episodes.summary: Jong Woo confides in a new neighbor, and they agree to look out for one another. So Jung Hwa's investigation finally develops some leads.

episodes.title: Voices that Choke Me
episodes.summary: Moon Jo helps out Jong Woo when he's arrested after a brawl. While the act of kindness intensifies Jong Woo's fear, something violent stirs from within.

episodes.title: Cognitive Dissonance
episodes.summary: Suspecting that Kang Suk Yoon's message is a cry for help, Jong Woo goes back into Eden to pull him out. But Suk Yoon nervously admits it was a joke.

episodes.title: Gaslighting
episodes.summary: Moon Jo dares Jong Woo to commit his first murder if he ever wants to see Ji Eun again. When Jong Woo refuses, his bloodthirsty neighbor is dissatisfied.
